[Shot 1] The shot begins from <Picture 1>. The hands twist and weave the braids with steady rhythm, morning light shifts across the porch, while the camera pushes slowly in, one continuous move with strong, clear motion for the whole five seconds, never slowing to a stop.
[Shot 2] At 00:05.000, the camera cuts to <Picture 2>. The family dances and spins in the sunlit grass, the kids twirl and the herb plants sway, while the camera drifts slowly around them, one continuous move with strong, clear motion for the whole five seconds, never slowing to a stop.
